description: Java implementation of MerchantStore data access object (DAO) providing methods to fetch merchant store data and associated products, utilizing Hibernate and QueryDSL for database operations.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MerchantStoreDao for database operations related to MerchantStore entities with methods for fetching products and store details.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches collection of Products associated with the given MerchantStore, executing a complex HQL query with multiple joins to fetch related entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore entity by its ID, using QueryDSL to construct the query with fetched relationships.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore entity by its code, leveraging QueryDSL to perform a fetch with related entities.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Overloaded method to fetch MerchantStore by ID, similar to getById, using QueryDSL.
